description: Python dependencies are declared canonically in pyproject.toml using PEP 621 and PEP 735. No generated requirements or lockfile is committed during the FastMCP 4 / MCP 2 migration.

packageRules.description: Keep official Python Docker base images on the 3.12 line (matches the deployment runtime)
Do not auto-bump the project Python constraint; align it manually with the CI matrix and Vercel runtime

frontend: `typescript` stays on 6 because typescript-eslint cannot run on TypeScript 7 (it has no JS compiler API). The native compiler is installed separately as `typescript-7` for typecheck and build; when typescript-eslint supports 7, drop the alias and lift this rule
